name: app-fitness-three-screens-with-blue-orange-ring-and-flat-illustrations
title: Blue and Orange Fitness App with Flat Illustrations
whatItIs: Three light grey phones on blue-grey: an Activities screen with a dark and blue ring and a run time, a home with a date strip, an exercise illustration, oxygen and heart rate cards and an activity plan of coloured capsules on a timeline, and an onboarding 'Level Up Your Health Game' with a flat illustration of a weightlifter and floating icons, plus a dark tab bar with a blue active circle.
whatItMeans: A restrained blue, orange and black palette with flat illustrations feels sporty and clear.
techniques: Double ring chart for run progress
Capsule timeline for the activity plan
Flat illustration with floating icon bubbles
Highlighted headline word on a blue block
Dark tab bar with a blue circle for the active tab

vocabulary.definition: Rounded bars laid on a time scale.
A vector drawing with solid colours and no gradients.
A circle with an icon placed around an illustration.
